corsairCables.scope: Check the exact PSU revision and cable type; a modular connector shape does not establish a safe match.

msiB850Max.scope: AM5, DDR5, DIMM and nominal storage counts, published memory limit and ATX. BIOS and shared-slot configurations remain separate checks.

msiX870Carbon.scope: Facts use the correctly named X870E specification table only, excluding an unrelated legacy Z690 block farther down this page. M2_2 is unavailable with Ryzen 8000; bandwidth sharing is unresolved here.

msiB650MA.scope: AM5, DDR5, DIMMs, published memory limit and mATX. Nominal M.2 count is conditional: M2_2 is unavailable with Ryzen 8500/8300.

msiZ790.scope: DDR5 version only. DIMMs, published memory limit, nominal storage counts and ATX; no minimum BIOS is inferred.

msiZ790Sheet.scope: Exact named datasheet table establishes LGA1700. This is not the DDR4 or MAX model and is not proof of a shipped BIOS version.

asusB550F.scope: Original Wi-Fi model: AM4, DDR4, four DIMMs, 128 GB, ATX and nominal storage counts. WIFI II and the non-Wi-Fi model are distinct and do not inherit this evidence.

amd7800.scope: AM5, DDR5, 128 GB CPU memory limit, default 120 W TDP, graphics capability and no included boxed cooler. Profile operation and board BIOS are separate.

amd9950X3D.scope: AM5, DDR5, 256 GB CPU memory limit, default 170 W TDP, graphics capability and no included boxed cooler.

amd5700X3D.scope: Official support page specification section: AM4, DDR4, 128 GB limit, default 105 W TDP, discrete graphics required and no included boxed cooler. Product-page fetch failed; no fact is based only on a snippet.

intel265K.scope: FCLGA1851 normalized to LGA1851; DDR5, 256 GB limit and integrated graphics. Processor base power and maximum turbo power remain separately labeled, not measured consumption.

intel14700K.scope: FCLGA1700 normalized to LGA1700; DDR4 or DDR5 depending on motherboard, 192 GB limit and UHD 770 graphics. Uses the inspected 236783 exact K-model page, not KF or the inaccessible inherited 236789 URL.

msi5070Ventus.scope: Exact OC card dimensions, published board power, one 16-pin input and PSU recommendation. Not the non-OC, Ti, 2X or white model.

asus5070Prime.scope: 304 × 126 × 50 mm, one 16-pin input and 750 W recommended PSU. ASUS bases that recommendation on an overclocked CPU/GPU system; board power is not specified here.

msi3060VentusOC.scope: Exact 12 GB OC card dimensions, board power, one PCIe 8-pin input and PSU recommendation. 8 GB, non-OC and other VENTUS variants are separate.

msiX870Tomahawk.scope: AM5, DDR5, four DIMMs, 256 GB published limit, ATX and nominal storage counts. M2_2 is unavailable with Ryzen 8500/8300 and shares bandwidth with USB4; exact BIOS and occupied-slot layout remain unresolved.

corsairRM8502021.scope: Exact SKU page verifies 850 W rated output, ATX form, 160 mm body length and Type 4 cables. Separate from RM850x 2018, 2024/2025 and SHIFT. Cable routing and connector inventory are not certified.

bequiet850.scope: Exact named product and article number: 850 W rated output, 160 × 150 × 86 mm body. Current page describes ATX 3.1/12V-2x6 while inherited record dates to 2023; connector revision and standards are deliberately unresolved.

samsung980.scope: Exact non-heatsink 1 TB model: PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe 1.3c, M.2 2280 and nominal capacity. Other capacities and heatsink versions do not inherit this evidence.

samsung990Evo2.scope: Exact 2 TB product table: PCIe 4.0 x4 / 5.0 x2, NVMe 2.0, M.2 2280 and rated capacity. This is not 990 EVO, 990 PRO or the 1 TB/4 TB capacities.

lianEvoWhite.scope: Explicit white model column: supported board forms, conditional E-ATX width, nominal GPU/cooler/PSU body allowances. Original EVO only, not EVO RGB or EVO XL. Nominal dimensions do not certify an assembled layout.

lianMiniSnow.scope: Explicit Snow model column verifies SFX/SFX-L PSU support, board forms, conditional E-ATX width and 170 mm cooler height. GPU LENGTH CLEARANCE says 395 mm but VGA Length says 370 mm; GPU length remains unresolved.
